description: Headline economic figures with period, change and source: inflation, unemployment, policy rates and US public debt, plus the next rate decisions. Use it for how the economy is doing, or one topic. Covers US CPI over 12 months and unemployment (Bureau of Labor Statistics), the effective federal funds rate with the Fed's target range and SOFR (New York Fed), euro-area inflation and the ECB deposit rate (ECB) and euro-area unemployment (Eurostat), Canada's inflation and unemployment (Statistics Canada), policy rate and the chartered banks' posted prime, 5-year mortgage and 5-year GIC rates (Bank of Canada), US national average savings and CD rates (FDIC), the UK's quoted 2- and 5-year fixed mortgage rates (Bank of England), the euro area's cost of borrowing for a home and household deposit rate (ECB), the UK's inflation and unemployment (Office for National Statistics) and Bank Rate (Bank of England), and US public debt (Treasury), each with about a year of history. Optional filter by topic, for example 'canada inflation', 'uk', 'mortgage' or 'savings'.

topic.description: Optional topic, for example 'inflation', 'jobs', 'rates', 'debt', 'euro' or 'canada'. Leave empty for all.
